intro: This zone takes in the northern half of Kohima and the old settlement the city is named after. Kohima Village, also called Kewhira and historically Bara Basti, holds the high ground on the north-eastern side and is not one of the numbered municipal wards. Beside it sit Kitsübozou, a ward incorporated in 1970, and Naga Bazaar, split into an upper and a lower part. Further north-west are Peraciezie, first on the municipal list, and Bayavü Hill, grouped with Sepfüzou, where the Nagaland Board of School Education has its head office. Together these five neighbourhoods run from the heights down towards Daklane and the centre.

Homes across the zone are spread over slopes, many sitting above or below the road and reached by stepped paths, so a street address alone rarely brings a tutor to the right door. Families here usually give the ward, its upper or lower part, a landmark and the point where a taxi can stop. Buses and taxis are how most people move around Kohima, and tutors from the southern wards reach the north through the busy central stretch, which makes the hour after offices close a poor choice for a start time. Rain is heaviest from June to September, so keeping an online slot in reserve helps.

Neighbouring wards here share tutors easily: one tutor might cover Kohima Village and Kitsübozou, another Peraciezie and Bayavü Hill. NXTutors builds every shortlist in that spirit, nearest first, looking at tutors who live in the zone, then those who travel here, then the rest of Kohima, then online tutors for subjects that are hard to staff locally. Each request brings two or three matched tutors, every fee is visible before the free first demo, and changing tutor later costs nothing. Students working towards the HSLC or HSSLC can ask for board experience when they send the request.
faqs: Which wards does the North Kohima & Kohima Village zone cover?

Five neighbourhoods: Kohima Village, Peraciezie, Bayavü Hill, Naga Bazaar and Kitsübozou. Together they make up the northern half of the city, from the old settlement on the north-eastern heights to the wards that lead down towards Daklane and the centre. Each one has its own area page on NXTutors listing nearby tutors.
Does having the board office in this zone help students?

It can help with paperwork. The Nagaland Board of School Education has its head office at Upper Bayavü Hill, so questions about HSLC or HSSLC registration can be taken there in person. A home tutor's role stays the same, though: steady weekly study, practice on past papers and revision.
What time of day suits a tutor travelling into the northern wards?

A start after the evening office rush has eased. Tutors coming from Midland, the Chandmari wards or further south pass through the central stretch, which is busiest when offices close. Tutors already living in Naga Bazaar, Peraciezie or Kitsübozou can usually manage an earlier slot straight after school.
If no tutor lives near our home in the north, what does NXTutors do?

It widens the search step by step. NXTutors looks first at tutors in the zone, then at those who travel here, then across Kohima, and finally at online tutors. You still get two or three matched names, see each fee before booking, and the first class is a free demo.

intro: The Main Town & Midland zone is the middle of Kohima. Daklane and New Market are the central wards most people pass through, with Naga Bazaar to the north and Midland to the south. Midland itself, incorporated in 1970, divides into Upper, Middle and Lower Midland. On the western side, Officers' Hill, officially Thegabakha, sits between the centre and the southern wards around PR Hill and Merhülietsa. Daklane and New Market sit close to the central market and are busiest by day, and Daklane and Officers' Hill both have schools of their own, so children from primary level upwards study nearby.

For tutors, this is the easiest zone to reach and the hardest to time. Most routes across the city pass through or near these wards, so tutors from the north, south and west can all get here, usually by bus, taxi or two-wheeler. The catch is traffic: roads are busiest when offices open and close, and parking on the central roads can be tight, especially around New Market. Hill roads at Officers' Hill can be narrow too. Say where a scooter can wait, name your part of Midland, and pick a start time once the evening peak has passed.

Because the zone is central, a tutor from almost any ward can be considered for a home here, which helps when a student needs a senior subject under the HSSLC or CBSE. NXTutors still starts with tutors living in these four wards, then those who list the zone among the places they travel to, then the rest of Kohima, then online. You compare two or three matched tutors, see each fee before the free first demo, and can switch later at no cost. A home tutor for one core subject and an online tutor for a second is a mix some families in Classes 11 and 12 use.
faqs: Why is the Main Town & Midland zone easy for tutors to reach?

Because it is the centre of Kohima. Daklane and New Market lie on routes that cross the city, Midland adjoins them to the south and Officers' Hill sits to the west, so tutors from the northern, southern and western wards can all get here by bus, taxi or two-wheeler.
Where should a tutor park when visiting a home in the central wards?

Wherever the family suggests, so say it when booking. Parking on the central roads around New Market can be tight, and the hill roads at Officers' Hill can be narrow. If your home has a spot for a scooter, mention it; otherwise a taxi to a named landmark often works better.
Do weekday office hours affect home lessons in this zone?

Yes, more than anywhere else in Kohima. Roads through Daklane, New Market and Midland are busiest when offices open and close, so after-school slots that begin once the evening peak has passed run more smoothly. Families in Upper, Middle or Lower Midland should also say which part they live in.
How are tutor fees shown for families in the central wards?

On each tutor's profile, before you book, and every tutor sets their own rate. Across NXTutors, most home-tuition sessions fall between ₹800 and ₹2,500 an hour; Classes 11–12, IB/IGCSE and JEE/NEET sit toward the upper end; specialists for IB HL or JEE Advanced can charge more.

intro: Chandmari & PR Hill covers the southern side of central Kohima: Upper Chandmari and Lower Chandmari, which are separate wards despite their shared name, and PR Hill, short for P.R. Hill, whose municipal ward also includes Lower PR Hill and one adjoining neighbourhood. Midland and the town centre lie to the north, Officers' Hill to the north-west, and Agri Farm and Merhülietsa to the west. Two landmarks help with directions: the Capital Cultural Centre at PR Hill, a public venue that taxi drivers know, and a large place of worship in Lower Chandmari that opened in 2017.

Homes here are spread across the slopes, so the most useful thing a family can send is which Chandmari ward it is in, or which level of PR Hill, plus a landmark and the nearest taxi stop. Schools sit within the zone, including a higher secondary school in Upper Chandmari and schools in Lower PR Hill, so students from primary classes up to Class 12 can study close to home. Weekday roads towards the centre fill at office hours, which is why late-afternoon or evening sessions travel more easily, and an online class covers the heaviest monsoon weeks between June and September.

Tutors living in the three wards, or in Midland and Officers' Hill next door, are the natural first choice for regular visits. NXTutors starts there, widens to tutors who travel into the zone, then the rest of Kohima, and adds online tutors for subjects such as accountancy or computer science in the senior classes. Each request returns two or three matched tutors with fees shown up front; the first class is a free demo, and if the match stops working, a switch costs nothing. Board-year students on the HSLC or HSSLC should fix their timetable before winter, when extra sessions are usually wanted.
faqs: Which neighbourhoods make up the Chandmari & PR Hill zone?

Upper Chandmari, Lower Chandmari and PR Hill, including Lower PR Hill. They form the southern side of central Kohima, below Midland and the town centre, with Officers' Hill to the north-west and the Agri Farm wards to the west. Each has its own area page listing nearby tutors.
Can one tutor teach students in both Chandmari wards and PR Hill?

Yes, the three sit side by side. Upper Chandmari has PR Hill to its west and Lower Chandmari next door, so a tutor living in any of them can reach the others for weekly visits. Tutors from Midland, just to the north, are also well placed for these homes.
How should a board-year student in Chandmari or PR Hill plan the year?

Fix the timetable before winter. Students preparing for the HSLC or HSSLC usually want extra sessions from the winter onwards, and booking early keeps the same tutor's evening slot. During the June to September monsoon, swapping one weekly home visit for an online class keeps revision moving.
Does NXTutors only suggest tutors who live in Chandmari or PR Hill?

No, it starts with them and then widens. NXTutors looks at tutors in the zone first, then tutors who travel to it, then the rest of Kohima, then online. You get two or three matched options, see every fee before booking, and the first class is a free demo.

intro: Lerie & Agri Farm is the southern and south-western edge of Kohima. Lerie shares a municipal ward with New Ministers' Hill and New Reserve. Agri Farm's ward also takes in Upper Mediezie, called Upper Agri, along with the Electrical and Forest neighbourhoods, while Merhülietsa's ward includes Lower Mediezie, or Lower Agri. Pulie Badze, the peak to the south-west, overlooks this side of the city. PR Hill and the Chandmari wards lie to the east, and Officers' Hill is next to Merhülietsa. Lerie and Merhülietsa both have schools of their own, so many children here study close to home.

Many addresses here are smaller neighbourhoods inside a larger ward, and similar names, Upper Agri and Lower Agri in particular, belong to different wards. So give both your neighbourhood and its ward, a landmark, and whether the house is above or below the road; hillside paths in Merhülietsa can be steep. Tutors from the northern wards have to cross the busy centre to get here, so they tend to prefer later evening or weekend sessions, while tutors living in PR Hill or the Chandmari wards can manage a slot straight after school. Heavy rain from June to September is a reason to keep one session a week online.

NXTutors looks first for tutors living in Lerie, Agri Farm or Merhülietsa, then those who travel to this edge of the city, then the rest of Kohima, then online. That order matters more here than in the centre, because a short trip is what keeps a weekly slot going through the term. Each request brings two or three matched tutors, each fee is on the profile before the free first demo, and switching later is free. Families on the Nagaland Board of School Education can ask for HSLC or HSSLC experience, CBSE families for that syllabus, and online tutors can cover specialist Class 11 and 12 subjects.
faqs: Which neighbourhoods fall within the Lerie & Agri Farm zone?

Lerie, with New Ministers' Hill and New Reserve; Agri Farm, with Upper Agri, Electrical and Forest; and Merhülietsa, with Lower Agri. Together they form the southern and south-western edge of Kohima, beside PR Hill and the Chandmari wards, with Pulie Badze overlooking them from the south-west.
Why do families in the Agri neighbourhoods need precise addresses?

Because Upper Agri and Lower Agri sound alike but sit in different wards, one with Agri Farm and the other with Merhülietsa. A tutor told only 'Agri' could head the wrong way, so put the neighbourhood, the ward and a landmark in the request, and say where a taxi can stop.
When can tutors from north Kohima teach in Lerie or Merhülietsa?

Usually later in the evening or at weekends. Reaching this edge of the city from the northern wards means crossing the busy centre, which is slowest when offices close. Tutors living in PR Hill, Agri Farm or the Chandmari wards can more easily take a slot straight after school.
Can a family on this edge of Kohima still find a tutor for senior subjects?

Yes. NXTutors matches two or three tutors, nearest first, and adds online tutors when a Class 11 or 12 subject has no one close by. You see each fee before booking, try the tutor at a free first demo, and can change tutors later at no cost.
